source_strategy: Individually licensed GBIF exact-source taxon determinations with readable image bytes and near-duplicate screen. Joey Texas and personal iNaturalist inventories remain permitted sources in future manual passes, subject to per-photo rights and ID confirmation.
safety: Preserve original photos, taxonomy/range and scientific HOLDs
Do not install when current gallery is no longer exactly one photo or another lane owns species
Do not invent arrows/labels for uninspected anatomy
Verify GitHub commit and real bytes before counting success
